title: Weld Tech Group - Industry Solutions
meta_description: Weld Tech Group solutions for food, chemical, pharmaceutical and other industries. We take into account the sanitary, technical and production requirements of each industry.
main_description: The Weld Tech Group company implements projects for various industries, taking into account specific requirements for installation, hygiene, safety and efficiency.

specificity.title: Specificity and Tasks:
specificity.item1: Strict sanitary and hygienic requirements (e.g., HACCP).
specificity.item2: Need for flawless weld quality and ease of sanitary equipment processing.
specificity.item3: Use of stainless steels and materials that comply with food safety.

offer.title: What We Offer:
offer.item1: Design and installation of pipeline systems for liquid and bulk products.
offer.item2: Manufacturing of specialized tanks (for milk, beer, juices, etc.) considering thermal treatment or cooling.
offer.item3: Manufacturing of additional structures (conveyors, rollers, washing baths), adapted to high humidity and aggressive cleaning agents.

specificity.title: Specificity and Tasks:
specificity.item1: Aggressive environments (acids, alkalis, organic solvents, etc.).
specificity.item2: Detailed requirements for tightness, corrosion resistance and personnel safety.
specificity.item3: Need for specialized equipment for storage and processing of chemical substances.

offer.title: What We Offer:
offer.item1: Manufacturing of tanks and pipelines for working with aggressive chemical environments.
offer.item2: Durable metal structures, resistant to corrosion and temperature fluctuations.
offer.item3: Possibility to manufacture non-standard systems for specialized technological processes.

specificity.title: Specificity and Tasks:
specificity.item1: Strict purity requirements (GMP, FDA and others).
specificity.item2: Full compliance with high sterility standards and prevention of cross-contamination.
specificity.item3: Use of high-purity alloys with minimal impurity content.

offer.title: What We Offer:
offer.item1: Installation of pipelines and systems for storage of high-purity environments (water for injection, pharmaceutical steam).
offer.item2: Manufacturing of tanks with special internal surface treatment (polishing, passivation).
offer.item3: High-precision welding (e.g., orbital), minimizing roughness and welds that retain microorganisms.

other_industries.title: Other Industries and Directions
other_industries.description: Besides key areas (food, chemical, pharmaceutical), we also work with companies from:

energy.title: Energy
energy.description: Pipelines for steam, gas, compressed air, installation of metal structures for boiler houses and turbine halls.

construction.title: Construction Machinery
construction.description: Manufacturing and installation of components for production lines, including welding of complex metal structures.

oil_gas.title: Oil and Gas Sector
oil_gas.description: Tanks for petroleum products, gas pipelines, corresponding fittings.
